notes.note: Reviewed the generated privacy-policy delta and existing privacy links. The disclosure now states that the first cumulative report after a resume/reattach is a baseline and may omit part of the first resumed turn. Outside CLI use remains excluded; default lifetime accounting and separate data-flow/publication qualification remain unchanged. Generator/fixture evidence is not a deployed privacy assessment.

Reviewed the round-2 daily-throughput delta against this document and callers. Only the Lite daily observation allocation opts into resumed cumulative component baselines; default session/lifetime totals, per-turn providers, authorization and lifecycle writers remain unchanged. The option withholds each first resumed component from dated usage, retaining later increases. No endpoint, provider launch or release claim changes. Delta source review, not live-provider or installed/native qualification.

Traced conservative resume allocation through the canonical fold and daily reader: repeated cumulative starts, explicit recorded resumes and initially matched native resumes withhold the first reported token component; sparse components baseline independently and later increases count. Default lifetime and per-turn accounting are unchanged. Reviewed the first-resumed-turn undercount beside the retained reset/correction undercount, catalog notice revision and regenerated privacy/Lite inventories. Mounted Lite accessible description again includes daily counts plus coarse tokens per engine. Regression runs were red before repair; cache boundary, every-read lock and runtime scope mutations were each caught, then restored. Six affected suites passed 217/217. Component renders inspected at two widths/themes; no live-provider, native, production rollout or release qualification.
